900.2.10(604).explanation: On lands in exception R 604, an apartment building is not allowed. No older by-laws prevail.

900.2.10(930).explanation: On lands in exception R 930: a detached-house lot needs at least 7.5 m of frontage; additions above the first storey of an existing detached house must meet the standard setbacks; a garage door through the front wall of the house is not allowed; and a rear deck or balcony more than 1.2 m above grade is capped at 4.0 m2, must stay 1.8 m from the side lot lines and may not extend into the required rear yard. Several sections of former By-law 438-86, and site by-laws for named addresses on Petman Ave. and Whitewood Rd., also prevail.

900.2.10(322).explanation: Exception R 322 adds no site specific rules; older site by-laws prevail on named addresses on Coxwell Ave., Donlands Ave., Eaton Ave. and Strathmore Blvd.

900.2.10(804).explanation: Lands in exception R 804 must also comply with exception R 7; older site by-laws prevail at 142 Argyle St. and 259-259D Dovercourt Road.
